it.skip — ⚑ the prose supplies NO trigger for a 5 sec window, so passive vs interval-on-skill-cooldown vs per-shot is outside the input domain. Flagged, never guessed; the uptime fraction is unknowable from kit text alone.

Full-burst COUNT (burstCdr emits no event) bracketed strictly inside flat-1.82 and flat-6.62 constructed counterfactuals and strictly above a 0-sec floor, plus monotonically shrinking FB-to-FB gaps. Fails under a non-escalating flat model (equal gaps, count pinned at the flat-1.82 floor) and under an instantly-maxed model.
Self-only CDR counterfactual yields strictly fewer Full Bursts. Fails under a self-scoped model, which cannot speed the B1/B3 chain links that actually gate the rotation.

atkPct-7.72 applies == dollaBurstCasts × allyCount exactly. Fails under a fullBurstEnter keying, which yields fbCount × allyCount (strictly more in this fixture — asserted directly in the counterfactual).

critRatePct-4.21 applies == max(0, casts-1) × allyCount. Fails under a non-escalating model (fires from cast 1) and under a replace-not-accumulate model (would suppress the step-1 ATK buff on later casts).
critDamagePct-13.22 applies == max(0, casts-2) × allyCount, and step 1/2 counts keep climbing past cast 3. Fails under a model that resets the escalation or caps at step 1.
durationShots undefined on all three step buffs — rules out the ROUND-count duration trap; wall-clock seconds only.
Linearity: (doubled − base) / (base − zeroed) ≈ 1, pinning the magnitude without knowing final ATK. Fails under any non-linear or mis-bucketed encoding, and under a 0/absent burst hit.

One damage event per dolla burst cast with fbMajorApplied falsy and rangeApplied falsy. Fails under a model that lets the burst cast take the +50% Full-Burst major (cast resolves before the FB window opens) or the +30% range bonus.

fixtures: controlComp('dolla', true) only — liter(B1) / crown(B2) / dolla(B2) / helm(B3), boss Fire, focus dolla, deterministic (no seed), 9 hoisted 180s runs (base + 8 counterfactuals). The fixed-B3 slot is REQUIRED: dolla is Burst II, so without a B3 the chain never completes and both the fullBurstEnter and the burstCast channels go dead. Sharing the Burst II stage with crown is deliberate rather than a confound — it is the only thing that makes dolla's own-cast count diverge from the team full-burst count, which is exactly the discrimination S2b's 'when using Burst Skill' needs. A dedicated non-vacuity describe() asserts both cases occur (casts >= 1 AND fbCount > casts); if either fails the fixture, not the model, is the finding.
gaps: skill1 activation cadence — ⚑ the kit prose carries NO activation clause for a 5 sec buff, so trigger identity (passive / interval-on-skill-cooldown / per-shot) and the resulting uptime fraction are outside the input domain. Estimate + recipe: if modeled as an interval trigger, the period is the datamined skill cooldown (not present in this packet) and first-fire phase is a convention; measurement-gated, flagged not guessed.
burst 'Affects 1 enemy unit(s) with the highest final DEF' — no enemy entity/selection channel in the v1 sim; unobservable.
burst hit crit/core disposition — the prose names no core strike and no crit clause; asserting either way would be invention.

S2a exact per-step CDR seconds — burstCdr emits no event, so the escalation is only provable to bracketing strength (count between flat-1.82 and flat-6.62, plus shrinking FB gaps). If the fixture's full-burst spacing turns out to be gauge-bound rather than cooldown-bound, the sensitivity assertion (fbCount(flat-6.62) > fbCount(0)) fails FIRST and marks the whole group unprovable in this comp — that is the intended diagnostic, not a model verdict.

Event unit-attribution and the srcSlot value ('burst') are not part of the documented harness contract; actorOf() probes several plausible field names and a miss surfaces as a hard count mismatch in the burst FB-exemption test rather than a silently empty filter.
